hardBudgetFinding.provedNarrowCorrection: Record formerly reconstructed an entire premise view for initial derivation, each tentative premise deletion and final fact minimization. The correction constructs one view then reconstructs only the changed cell by AND-ing complements of all still-included candidate removals for that cell and restores exact state if Holds fails.

requiredHunk: Build View(included) once before first Holds.
On each newest-first tentative deletion, recompute only entries[j].Cell from currently included candidate entries using remaining=127 and bitwise removal intersection.
On failed Holds, restore both included[j] and saved view cell.
Pass the final same view to MinimalFacts.
